title: 第9章 再遇花豹，铁箭之威
novel_title: 乱世武道：从山村猎户开始狂肝箭术
content_zh:
陆林摆好姿势。

    陆大勇家有现成的箭靶，而且院子宽敞，左右约有三十步的长度。

    陆林张弓搭箭。

    双目一凝。

    箭靶似乎在他眼中放大。

    陆林可以清晰的看清靶心。

    六力弓在陆林手上，被他一点点拉开。

    虽说有些重，但拉起来并不困难。

    看来箭术几次升级，那一股热流对他身体帮助不小。

    不知道再升一级，能不能帮助陆林拉开九力弓。

    普通人使用弓箭。

    三力弓用来入门练习。

    能用六力弓，那就能算得上军中好射手。

    若是能拉得动九力弓，若是进了军营，那绝对是了不得的高手。

    陆林摒弃杂念，凝神，放匀呼吸。

    右手送弦。

    重达七钱的铁箭直飞而出。

    在六力弓的强力推动下。

    铁箭在空中划过一道直线。

    “铎——”

    铁箭的箭尖稳稳扎在箭靶中心。

    许是陆林用的力气太大，箭尾不断颤抖。

    对比木箭，铁箭虽然重了一些。

    但在更强大的拉力作用下，速度比起木箭还要快出一大截。

    还有就是攻击力了。

    木箭只有射中猎物的眼睛，才能造成杀伤。

    可换成铁箭……恐怕除了野猪老虎黑熊这种皮糙肉厚的猛兽，没有哪种动物能够扛得住这一箭之威。

    陆林又射了几箭。

    对自己的力量和耐力，做出一个评估。

    二十箭。

    若是换到左手，那还能再加十箭。

    有这样的能力，只要箭矢不耗尽，陆林就能持续输出。

    进屋。

    “怎么样，可能拉的开这六力弓？”

    陆大勇明知故问。

    他听到陆林射箭中靶的声音。

    “大勇叔，你说的事我答应了，不过你也知道，这山里的事咱们猎户说了不算，什么时候能遇到那一家野猪……”

    “老子还要你个毛头小子教！”

    陆大勇一瞪眼，他自然明白陆林的意思。

    “这弓你拿去用，准猎证也借给你，反正老子短时间内进不了山，但箭矢若有损耗……”

    “自然是我来补齐。”

    陆林一口答应下来。

    陆大勇满意不已，又传授了陆林一些冬季山林中的生存，寻找猎物踪迹的经验。

    陆林借口饭蒸好了，给父子俩送上吃的，背着弓箭离去。

    这时已到午时。

    陆林肚子也不饿。

    加上早上跟嫂嫂发生的事，他也不敢回家，干脆选择进山。

    “诶，陆老二，你这是要进山打猎？”

    村口，恰巧遇到孙友成的跟班。
content_en:
Lu Lin took a pose.

    Lu Dayong's family has a ready-made archery target, and the yard is spacious, about thirty steps from left to right.

    Lu Lin drew his bow and drew an arrow.

    His eyes narrowed.

    The target seemed to magnify in his eyes.

    Lu Lin could see the bullseye clearly.

    The Liuli Bow was in Lu Lin's hand, and he pulled it apart little by little.

    Although it is a bit heavy, it is not difficult to pull up.

    It seems that his archery skills have been upgraded several times, and the heat has helped his body a lot.

    I wonder if upgrading to another level can help Lu Lin draw the Nine Power Bow.

    Ordinary people use bows and arrows.

    The triforce bow is used for introductory exercises.

    If you can use a six-power bow, you can be considered a good archer in the army.

    If you can pull the Nine Power Bow and enter the military camp, you will definitely be an incredible master.

    Lu Lin abandoned distracting thoughts, concentrated, and breathed evenly.

    The right hand sends the string.

    An iron arrow weighing seven coins flew straight out.

    Under the strong push of the six-force bow.

    The iron arrow drew a straight line in the air.

    "Duo——"

    The tip of the iron arrow was firmly planted in the center of the target.

    Perhaps Lu Lin used too much force and the arrow tail kept trembling.

    Compared with wooden arrows, iron arrows are heavier.

    But under the stronger pulling force, the speed is much faster than the wooden arrow.

    There is also attack power.

    Wooden arrows can only cause damage if they hit the prey's eyes.

    It can be replaced by an iron arrow... I am afraid that except for rough-skinned beasts like wild boars, tigers and black bears, no animal can withstand the power of this arrow.

    Lu Lin shot a few more arrows.

    Make an assessment of your strength and endurance.

    Twenty arrows.

    If you switch to your left hand, you can add ten more arrows.

    With this ability, Lu Lin can continue to output as long as the arrows are not exhausted.

    Go inside.

    "How about it, is it possible to draw this six-power bow?"

    Lu Dayong asked knowingly.

    He heard the sound of Lu Lin's arrow hitting the target.

    "Uncle Dayong, I agree to what you said, but you also know that we hunters have no say in what happens in the mountains. When can we meet that family of wild boars..."

    "I still want you, a young boy, to teach me!"

    Lu Dayong glared, and he naturally understood what Lu Lin meant.

    "You can use this bow, and I will lend you the hunting license. Anyway, I won't be able to enter the mountain in a short time, but if the arrows are damaged..."

    "Of course I will make up for it."

    Lu Lin agreed immediately.

    Lu Dayong was very satisfied and taught Lu Lin some experience of surviving in the winter mountain forest and finding prey traces.

    Lu Lin used the excuse that the rice was steamed, gave food to the father and son, and left with his bow and arrow on his back.

    It was already noon.

    Lu Lin wasn't hungry either.

    In addition to what happened with his sister-in-law in the morning, he did not dare to go home and simply chose to go into the mountains.

    "Hey, Mr. Lu, are you going to go hunting in the mountains?"

    At the entrance of the village, I happened to meet Sun Youcheng's follower.
title_en: Chapter 9 Meeting the leopard again, the power of the iron arrow
